rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling shame or guilt, especially regret about your own actions.

example.english: I lied to you, and I’m really ashamed.
example.traditional: 我因為講大話呃咗你，真係好慚愧。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jan1 wai6 gong2 daai6 waa6 aak1 zo2 nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 caam4 kwai3

rows.note: Use this when being ashamed shades into feeling embarrassed, awkward, or sorry toward someone else.

example.english: I’m ashamed to have kept you waiting so long.
example.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 zo2 zyu6 nei5 gam3 noi6
